requirements.requirement: There were two case reports, reported in different years during the 2010s.
The two case reports concerned two individuals and reported the same particular disorder in both individuals.
The first case report was reported in a country that was the largest country of its dominant religion in the world at the time of its establishment.

In the first case report, the individual presented with a half-year history of pain in different parts of their body; the pain gradually worsened and caused difficulty in walking and moving their shoulders.

In another case report, the individual presented with complaints of pain and swelling in the upper part of their body, where a procedure involving the collection of tissue samples to test for disease had been performed two months earlier.
For the individual in that other case report, when they were younger, they had developed stiffness, which was followed by swelling four years later.
The requested attribute is the scientific name of the disorder that both case reports reported the individuals to have.
